pages.heading: Opening the way
pages.body: Look for an Ancient City and its large central gateway. Obtain a Sculk Catalyst to unlock the mod's key progression; the author lists Warden drops and chest finds as sources. Craft the Depths Key using a catalyst, three bones

pages.heading: Opening the way (cont.)
pages.body: and an Echo Shard. Use the key at the Ancient City gateway. This is Call from the Depths, so portal instructions for similarly named Deep Dark mods may not apply.

pages.heading: Safe new arrivals
pages.body: The normal igniter can create an immersive Depths route. New destination frames and landing rooms stay between Y=5 and Y=122 and avoid occupied or unsafe space. Existing portals stay where they were built; failed conversion keeps normal travel.

pages.heading: Prepare for the cold
pages.body: The Depth Dimension is extremely chilly on KNCraft. Bring cold-insulated armor, warmed waterskins, food, light and blocks. Mark the entrance and begin with a short reconnaissance trip. Do not spend your remaining warmth chasing an unfamiliar

pages.heading: Prepare for the cold (cont.)
pages.body: structure. Return while you still have supplies to recover. A route that was clear on arrival may be harder to recognize in the dark.

pages.heading: What to expect
pages.body: This is a sculk-covered dimension with distinct biomes, ruins, creatures and its own progression. Some locations are meant to be approached later. Travel slowly enough to notice changes in the ground and the creatures nearby.

pages.heading: What to expect (cont.)
pages.body: Keep important discoveries marked, leave space for unfamiliar materials, and examine new items before using them. This guide does not reveal the dimension's boss encounters or late progression.
